info.name: MINI WMS - Core API
info.description: Authentication and all core warehouse endpoints. Set Admin email/password locally. Business flow - run in order creates review data and tests receipts, issues, inventory counts, Staff creation and ban/unban. Security folders deliberately revoke sessions. Password and token variable defaults are empty.

item.name: Security checks - intentionally revokes sessions
item.description: Run in order. The second login invalidates the first. Replaying a consumed refresh token then revokes the current family; sign in again afterwards.

item.name: Business flow - run in order
item.description: Run from the first request with Admin email/password configured. Creates persistent review data. Tokens and identifiers are captured locally. Requires real PostgreSQL and Redis.

item.name: Check failed issue left stock unchanged

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test("Absolute count changed 7.25 to 5", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.previousQuantity).to.equal(7.25); pm.expect(b.quantity).to.equal(5); });
